name: Facet
text: Choose a single high-contrast dark theme as default with adjustable saturation and font size. This keeps the interface sharp and readable for long sessions while letting users tweak it to their eyes. Trade-off: forcing one theme means we lose the flexibility of multiple themes, but it cuts visual noise and speeds up development.

name: Pane
text: Pane: One theme locks out users who need light mode for accessibility or migraines—saturation and font tweaks won’t cover that. The real risk is legal exposure and lost users. Settle it with user testing: measure readability and comfort in both light and dark modes before deciding.
